text:
Maria: thinking about a low-key LAN this Friday — i dug out my old Game Boy Pocket + link cable, thought it would be hilarious to do a tiny 2-player speedrun / smash-style bracket on handhelds. who'd be up for it? :retro:
Devon: count me in. i will bring a ds lite and some spare batteries.
Sam: i have an OG gbc and a weird chinese link cable adapter. maybe i'll bring it as backup.
Lee: i'm more of a controller hoarder but i'll bring adapters. also can someone bring a charging bank? pockets die fast. :battery:
Ashleigh: i'm down for the chaos. can we do a 10-15min round robin instead of single elim? more chances to trash talk. :smile:
Maria: yeah round robin sounds fun. thinking start at 6:30 after dinner-ish. we can use the mezz projector for a nostalgia mood.
Devon: projector + chiptune playlist = vibe. i'll bring a bluetooth speaker and some pizza money. who wants pepperoni? :pizza:
Sam: vegetarian here, pls half veg. also can we do a tiny prize? like a retro sticker or a mini trophy (plastic).
Lee: i can make a dumb pixel trophy out of cardstock.
lan-bot: Reminder: Mezzanine booking confirmed 18:00-22:00. Please clean up after event.
Ashleigh: quick poll: prefer 2v2 tag teams (switch partners each match) or 1v1 ladder?
Maria: i prefer ladder but tag teams sound hilarious with random pairing.
Devon: ladder keeps it competitive. tag teams if we want memes.
Sam: ladder, but fair to rotate so no one sits out too long.
Ashleigh: cool, ladder it is. Maria can you make a signup list?
Maria: sure — putting names in order of replies. current signups: Maria, Devon, Sam, Lee, Ashleigh. still room for a few more.
Lee: bringing spare batteries and an HDMI capture dongle if anyone wants to record a match for the 'office cringe' channel.
Devon: i call dibs on the capture for epic slow-mo fails.
Maria: rules idea: first to 3 rounds wins match, best two out of three for semis/final. small delay between sets to swap batteries.
Sam: also: check link cable polarity before match 3. i learned that the hard way.
Ashleigh: emoji reactions for signups: :thumbsup: means confirmed, :maybe: means might come, :x: means out. i'll sticky poll message in thread.
Maria: cool. i'll post a short checklist in #mezzanine-ops tomorrow (projector, speaker, pizza, batteries, capture). thanks y'all — hyped for tiny handheld chaos! :sparkles:
